title: Preventive maintenance without defined completion
source_story: User-provided fictional owner stories in this conversation; opening narrative below is a faithful condensed adaptation, not a verbatim transcript.
business_context: 11 staff; 38 school contracts with regular visits and reactive support.
owner_narrative: A visit usually means asking whether anything is broken and getting a signature. Different technicians check different things. We sometimes return for scheduled maintenance days after an emergency visit, yet a signed sheet can hide an inaccessible computer room.

diagnostic_interview.question: Does the contract require a visit or named checks?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: Several agreements list checks; others only specify frequency.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Obligations must be interpreted per agreement.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.

diagnostic_interview.question: Did emergency work satisfy those checks?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: The technician fixed one printer but did not inspect the lab.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Attendance cannot substitute for task evidence.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: How are inaccessible rooms recorded?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: The whole visit is marked complete.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: Can visits be combined?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: The customer permits it if checks are done within the due period.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

evidence.description: A simulated contract extract lists printer inspection and workstation checks.
A simulated report has a signature but no lab checklist.
A simulated access note records a locked room.

diagnoses.hypothesis: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.
diagnoses.counterhypothesis: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.
diagnoses.confidence_policy: Qualitative case-world support only; requires fresh customer evidence before reuse.

interventions.process_first: Translate reviewed contracts into task lists; distinguish attended, partially completed and obligation fulfilled.
interventions.deterministic_and_assisted_automation: Track due tasks per site and asset; suggest combining eligible checks with reactive visits; carry incomplete work forward.
interventions.rejected_default: Do not replace the whole service platform or deploy autonomous agents solely because the owner reports inefficiency.
interventions.selection_basis: Choose the least complex intervention addressing the supported handoff failure; compare added administration and integration burden.

requirements.statement: An emergency visit satisfies only evidenced tasks.
requirements.rationale: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.

requirements.statement: Signatures confirm the stated scope, not inaccessible work.
requirements.rationale: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.

requirements.statement: Blocked checks remain due unless an authorized exception is recorded.
requirements.rationale: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.

acceptance_tests.scenario_and_expected_result: A printer repair does not close the lab obligation.
An inaccessible room creates a follow-up task.
A completed eligible checklist suppresses only the corresponding duplicate planned work.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Contract obligation modelling and preventive scheduling are new capabilities.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.

evaluation.primary_metric_definition: Evidenced obligations completed on time / obligations due; count attendance separately.
measurement_cautions: Use a stable denominator and comparable operating periods.
Record missingness and changed case mix.
Do not infer staff reductions from reclaimed task minutes.

implementation.baseline: Collect at least one representative operating cycle before rollout; for monthly billing or maintenance include the relevant full cycle. Extend sampling when volumes or seasonality make the sample unrepresentative.
implementation.scope: Start with one consenting customer group and the staff who own its handoffs; include a normal case and each listed exception.
sequence: Reconcile identities and existing obligations with the process owner.
Run the proposed rules in shadow mode; record disagreements and missed exceptions.
Approve a bounded live pilot only after requirements and exceptions have named owners.
Review outcome metrics, added administrative work and failure logs before expanding.
implementation.simulated_resolution: In this fictional case, MILO introduced the process change: Translate reviewed contracts into task lists; distinguish attended, partially completed and obligation fulfilled. The team adopted the proposed workflow for the pilot scope. Routine coordination became explicit; unresolved exceptions continued to require a person.
implementation.simulated_lesson: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.
implementation.rollback: Pause automated writes and notifications, retain the event log, export outstanding work and return to a named manual coordinator. Reconcile queued events before resuming to avoid duplicate actions.
implementation.go_no_go: Process owner reviews coverage of acceptance cases, unresolved critical failures, metric direction and staff workload. No fixed performance threshold is claimed without customer agreement.

open_questions: Ambiguous contract wording needs human interpretation before scheduling rules are encoded.

transfer_rules.applicable_when: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.
transfer_rules.do_not_assume: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.
